title: Brain Leech
description:
[jitter]*thunk*[/jitter]

A sharp pain is felt atop your head and a thought stabs into your mind.

[purple][sine]"SHARE KNOWLEDGE???"[/sine][/purple]

You are unsure how to proceed...

options.title: Share Knowledge
options.description: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] random cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

options.title: Rip the Leech Off
options.description: Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Gain a Colorless card reward.

notes: The [gold]Share Knowledge[/gold] option presents a card selection screen where the player must choose 1 card from 5 randomly generated cards from their character's card pool. The [gold]Rip the Leech Off[/gold] option deals 5 damage (unblockable and not affected by powers) and grants a reward screen where a single Colorless card can be chosen.
